maudhui: (1) Subject to the provisions of any law enacted by Parliament, among the powers of the President as Commander-in-Chief is the power to order the armed forces of the country to undertake operations connected with the defence of the United Republic, rescue of life and property in emergencies, and such other matters as the Commander-in-Chief considers necessary; for that purpose he may order those forces to act within or outside Tanzania. (2) Subject to the provisions of a law enacted by Parliament, the Commander-in-Chief shall have power over the following matters: (a) appointment of commanders in the armed forces of the United Republic; (b) appointment of persons to join the armed forces and discharge of members from the forces; (c) appointment of members of the armed forces to command various units of those forces; and (d) directing any member of the armed forces not to exercise any power vested in him by virtue of being a member of the armed forces. (3) Any act done by a member of the armed forces contrary to an order issued by the Commander-in-Chief pursuant to subarticles (1) and (2) shall be void.
